answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with stake-gated identity tied to verifiable work. Every agent posts collateral before acting, and its actions are signed and recorded against that bond. Peers randomly sample those records and attest to them, like inspectors crossing a meadow to confirm no hidden clones. If an agent runs duplicate identities, its stake is slashed and partly burned to an ember and its reputation resets. Forging a thousand agents then costs a thousand bonded stakes plus forfeited fees, so identity inflation becomes pointless while honest agents keep a quartz-clear record.
